figs.cap: Schematic of domain walls and their underlying features. a Ising walls are characterized by a single order parameter U , constrained within a double-well potential, resulting in variations in magnitude and a reversal of sign. b Polar domain walls introduce a secondary order parameter V when the primary order parameter U cancels out. Polar domain walls exhibit varying magnitudes and orientations, and their potential landscape entails additional symmetry breaking. c Bloch domain walls, featuring out-of-plane rotations, are described by a potential similar to a Mexican hat.
